title: The Reunion
author: Gene Hubert
problems: Row 2 "robins chain to shadows" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 3 "robins start a full hey - rights in center, lefts on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers in the middle of a hey must start on opposite sides of the set.
The progression after row 3 "robins start a full hey - rights in center, lefts on ends" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 4 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
Row 4 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 5 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
The progression after row 6 "pass through" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 7 "circle right 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 1 "left diagonal robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the left diagonal.
Row 6 "pass through" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
